A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Safe Exploration via Policy Priors and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A-G. The reduction from 41 to 40 pages reflects layout changes rather than missing scientific content.

before.justification: Section 5 reports original benchmark, vision-control, offline-to-online, and physical race-car experiments. Appendix D contains additional original ablations, robustness tests, and hardware results.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix D retain the original experimental results, including benchmark comparisons, learning curves, safety measurements, and physical race-car evaluations.

M1.justification: SOOPER retains the same prior-policy fallback, online cost tracking, planning MDP, terminal rewards, and exploration/expansion objective in Algorithms 1-2 and Equations (5)-(9). Appendix C's extension to unknown reward and cost functions is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same RWRL, SafetyGym, and RaceCar tasks, including vision control, simulation transfer, offline-to-online learning, physical hardware, and the additional scenarios in Appendix D.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods: SAILR, CRPO, and Primal-Dual in the main experiments, plus the backup-policy variants, SafeCRPO, and Log Barriers comparisons in Appendix D.

E3.justification: The default 128-trajectory evaluation, undiscounted reward/cost metrics, prior-policy initialization, offline sample counts, and vision settings are unchanged. Appendices D-G retain identical experimental budgets, perturbations, and environment specifications.

E4.justification: Appendix D retains the same analyses of task misspecification, terminations, prior conservatism, non-Gaussian noise, pessimism, optimism, direct cost learning, and runtime. No ablation or robustness evidence is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five random seeds and retain the same uncertainty reporting, including mean and standard error for hardware results in Figures 6 and 14 and mean and standard deviation for runtime in Figure 16.

E6.justification: The matched experimental panels in Figures 3, 5-6, and 8-17 are visually identical, including plotted values, curves, and error bars. Their accompanying numerical statements and qualitative findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Assumptions 1-4, the mathematical definitions, Theorems 1-2, and the safety and regret proofs in Appendices A-B are unchanged. Appendix C's world-model extension is likewise identical; the small spacing edit in Figure 1 does not alter its mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about safety throughout learning, sublinear cumulative regret, scalability, and empirical performance. No contribution is added, strengthened, or narrowed.

C2.justification: The interpretations of policy priors, terminations, and optimism/pessimism tradeoffs are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same applicability boundaries and future directions concerning state-specific safety constraints, non-episodic learning, and more complex tasks.

D1.justification: The practical-implementation hyperlink in Section 4 changes its GitHub target from yardenas/safe-learning to lasgroup/safe-learning. This updates code-access information; the PDFs do not establish changes to code contents or availability. Printed implementation and reproducibility details are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to prior research are unchanged. Bibliography back-reference page numbers change with repagination, without changes to reference membership.

P1.justification: Section 2 corrects 'Bura et al. (2022) proposes' to 'propose'. The remaining narrative, terminology, and section order are retained, apart from routine version-identification updates.

P2.justification: v3 places acknowledgments and references directly after the conclusion on page 10, removing the large blank area in v1 and reflowing the bibliography. Figure 1 receives a small notation-spacing adjustment; other figures and tables retain their displays.

improvement.justification: The method, proofs, empirical evidence, and substantive explanations are unchanged. The grammar correction and tighter layout provide cosmetic refinement, while the updated repository link has no demonstrated effect on code availability within the supplied evidence. These limited edits do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
